messages:
miriam: Heads-up — saw a spike in requests showing up with no project attribution in the quota dashboard. Seems like SA proxying path loses origin header. Anyone else?
sam: Seen that. Looks like ~12% of requests last 6h are 'org:unknown'. impact: billing + alerts firing :grimacing:
jordan: pinging infra-bot to fetch traces for a sample request id
infra-bot: trace pulled for req_id=abc123. Header set: `X-Request-Origin: ` (empty). Upstream: auth-proxy v2.4.2
miriam: repro steps? can someone point to the parsing code that extracts project?
sam: check `auth-proxy/header_parser.go` line 78 — we only check `x-request-origin` and fall back to `x-api-key-org` but when using delegated SA flow the origin is in `x-delegated-project`.
jordan: aha. new proxy change in v2.4.2 introduced a rename. failing to map -> becomes originless. I'll open a PR to add fallback.
ux-lead: small ask — console should surface 'effective_project' column in the per-key chart, even if originless, so PMs can triage. Could be behind feature flag.
miriam: +1. even a telemetry tag `effective_project:unknown` would help. current alerts trigger too much noise.
sam: quick hotfix: on edge we can treat `Authorization: Bearer sa-token` and call token-introspect to fill project. But that's heavy.
jordan: I'll try simpler: patch header_parser to look for `x-delegated-project` then `x-api-key-project`, then `x-request-origin`. PR in a bit.
infra-bot: created issue #4123 with stack, added sample traces.
ux-lead: for rollout UX, suggest console shows count of recent "unattributed" requests with a one-click link to traces and last-seen header sample.
miriam: agrees. also add telemetry metric `auth.origin_fallback_used` with labels ["path", "model", "route"] so Optimize can reason about batching and cost.
sam: noted. I'll prototype metric and a dash widget.
jordan: PR 6823 opened: patch + unit test. deploying to staging now. logs look good.
miriam: awesome — once in staging let's run a synthetic that simulates delegated SA flows and confirm per-route tally in console.
ux-lead: filing a console story to add column and link. tagging @product.
sam: ETA to prod hotfix? if tests pass, will canary tonight.
miriam: thanks team :tada:
